recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. Do not delete historical source residue or old-type/history records under FHIR-14080 unless build tooling owners separately decide to purge out-of-build legacy artifacts.
issue_request: FHIR-14080 was Published/Persuasive with Modification and asked to remove the FHIR-core ImagingManifest resource because the MHD-I use case no longer used it and broader image object selection should use DICOM Key Object Selection rather than a FHIR resource.
initial_application: Commit d21acd48143d1cbe35a35616864c97839b13a361 applied GF#14080 by deleting imagingmanifest=ImagingManifest from source/fhir.ini's active [resources] list, adding imagingmanifest to [removed-resources], and removing the active ImagingManifest link from source/history.html.
additional_context: Current source/fhir.ini still excludes ImagingManifest from [resources] and retains it in [removed-resources]. Current source/history.html lists ImagingManifest as deleted/removed. Remaining source/imagingmanifest files plus fhir-old-types and resource-name-tracker references are historical/out-of-build compatibility material, and current source has no active source/imagingmanifest/structuredefinition-ImagingManifest.xml. Later Published issue FHIR-17183 introduced ImagingSelection for R5 as a separate capability without restoring ImagingManifest.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. The build-scoped current source already reflects the requested removal, and changing historical residue would be unnecessary without a separate build-tooling decision to purge legacy source folders.

related_jiras.note: Introduced ImagingSelection for R5 as a separate resource, confirming later imaging selection work did not reverse the ImagingManifest removal.
